services.headline: Engineered for Physical Production Tolerances
services.subheadline: We do not output rough vector outlines for screen preview. Every file is drafted to satisfy the unforgiving physical tolerances of printing presses, apparel screens, laser optics, and CNC blades.
services.c01Desc: Midjourney, DALL-E, and Ideogram concept art redrawn with mathematical accuracy. We eliminate pixel haze, remove phantom artifacts, and restore organic symmetry.
services.c01Best: Best For: Rebrands, agency pitch concepts, apparel logos.
services.c02Desc: Low-resolution scans, photographed business cards, and 72 DPI legacy web graphics rebuilt into infinitely scalable vectors without stair-stepping.
services.c02Best: Best For: Archival restorations, legacy client assets.
services.c03Desc: AI lettering is infamous for garbled glyphs. We identify authentic typefaces, re-typeset wording, or hand-craft bespoke vector letterforms with optical baseline harmony.
services.c03Best: Best For: Monograms, vintage badges, custom wordmarks.
services.c04Desc: Structured for apparel printing: spot color separations, Pantone Solid Coated callouts, underbase choking, and minimum line widths for silk screens.
services.c04Best: Best For: Screen printers, merch brands, DTF houses.
services.c05Desc: 100% closed loops, welded intersections, zero overlapping paths, and continuous curve direction to prevent plotter blade gouging.
services.c05Best: Best For: Vehicle wraps, signmakers, laser & CNC routers.
services.c06Desc: Streamlined vector paths engineered to avoid needle density overcrowding, thread snags, and stitch distortions on caps and outerwear.
services.c06Best: Best For: Uniform embroiderers, patch manufacturers.

moat.headline: Automatic Tools Convert Pixels. We Rebuild Artwork.
moat.subheadline: Why automated vectorization software fails when files reach commercial printers, CNC vinyl cutters, or embroidery digitizers.
moat.autoTitle: Automated Image Trace & Free AI Vectorizers
moat.autoPoints: Bloated Node Counts (10,000+ Points): Auto-trace drops anchor nodes at every pixel stair-step, choking CNC controllers and laser plotters.
moat.autoCurves: Jittery Non-Tangent Curves: Circles are never mathematically smooth; straight rules contain microscopic ripples.
moat.autoMuddy: Muddy Overlapping Polygons: Generates hundreds of micro-triangles instead of discrete, cleanly separated spot color plates.
moat.autoText: Unusable Pseudo-Lettering: AI characters remain deformed vector outlines that cannot be edited or cut.
moat.autoResult: Result: Machine jams, rejected print proofs, and costly ruined manufacturing stock.
moat.humanPoints: Minimal Extrema Nodes: Anchors placed strictly at curve apexes and inflection points for silky-smooth machine paths.
moat.humanCurves: True Mathematical Geometry: Arcs are genuine 360° beziers; corners are welded and snapped to exact angular grids.
moat.humanTrapping: Clean Spot Separations: Discrete spot layers choked and trapped for screen print emulsions and DTF transfers.
moat.humanText: Matched or Hand-Drafted Typography: AI pseudo-text replaced with authentic, razor-sharp typefaces and letterforms.
moat.humanResult: Result: Zero cutter gouging, flawless print registration, and infinite vector scalability.
